logLevel.description: Log level: 'info' for normal operation, 'debug' for detailed event logs

credentials.description: Langfuse credential groups. Each entry is one Langfuse project, optionally scoped to a set of agent IDs. Entries with no 'agentIds' (or an empty list) act as the default/catch-all group for any agent not matched by a more specific entry.

agentIds.description: Agent IDs this credential group applies to. Omit or leave empty to make this the default/catch-all group.

logLevel.label: Log Level
logLevel.help: Set to 'debug' to see which credential group was resolved for each exec call

credentials.label: Langfuse Credential Groups
credentials.help: One entry per Langfuse project. Scope an entry to specific agents via 'agentIds', or leave it unscoped to act as the default for any other agent.
